2026-12-06.40 Neural Information Processing Systems Conference
From Innovation Wiki of Australia Jump to navigation Jump to search The 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026) is being held in Sydney, Australia, from December 6–12, 2026. NeurIPS is the premier global multi-track interdisciplinary conference focused on advances in machine learning, deep learning, and computational neuroscience. The 2026 edition features a decentralized model combining the primary flagship physical venue in Australia with two coordinated international satellite locations.

excerpts: user avatar NeurIPS Conference @NeurIPSConf Following the success of the EurIPS and NeurIPS-Mexico City pilots in 2025, we are thrilled to announce two official NeurIPS 2026 satellite events for this year! These will be held in Paris, France and Atlanta, USA, respectively, running alongside the main venue in Sydney, Australia. Both satellite events will feature keynotes, oral and poster presentations of accepted NeurIPS 2026 papers, as well as workshops. We are planning tutorials, affinity events, and other elements for the satellite sites and we'll share more information as planning advances. Wherever you choose to join us, the entire NeurIPS organizing committee is working hard to deliver an outstanding experience for the whole community! user avatar NeurIPS Conference @NeurIPSConf
